formula: k_det=RFC6979_HMAC_SHA256(d,z) via ecdsa.rfc6979.generate_k; match iff k_det in {k, N-k}; exact match only; by source; no extra entropy; z as 32-byte BE of (z mod 2^256); d 32-byte BE
score_definition: exact_match rate overall and by source
expected_direction: many matches within one source => that source used RFC6979
holdout_split: full panel; primary split by source (not train/test bins)
trivial_exclusion_justification: Tests whether historical k equals RFC6979(d,z); attribution of signer, not P=[d]G verification as a sieve.
